title: Open Values Node Load Plan v0.1
description: The order in which the app should load the generated node and search files, what each stage needs, and what to do when a file fails to load. The data build writes it, and the app and its tests read it. It is an internal file used while building the site.

format.description: Names this file's format, so a reader can check it before reading the rest of the file.

version.description: The version of the format this file follows, such as "0.1".

built.description: The date of the source data this file was built from, as YYYY-MM-DD.

source.description: The script and files this file was built from, as paths in the repository.

purpose.description: One sentence on what this file is for.

appLaneNote.description: A note on which choices this file leaves to the app code that reads it, such as fetching, layout and wording.

integrityContract.description: The rules for cache keys and hash checks.

validate.description: When and how to check a loaded file against its hash in manifest.json.

retry.description: What to do after a hash mismatch or a parse failure.

fallback.description: What to do when a file still fails after the retry.

budgets.description: Byte sizes and limits for loading, by name, such as "askCoreBytes" and "startupBudgetBytes".

totals.description: How many stages there are, how many run in the app, and how many are for testing only.

id.description: A short id for the stage, such as "bootstrap-metadata".

label.description: A short name for the stage.

loadHint.description: When the files in this stage load, such as "eager-metadata", "eager", "eager-search", "defer-page-nodes", "lazy-product-search" or "dev-contract".

files.description: The file names in this stage.

trigger.description: What should start this stage loading.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Checks the app must pass for this stage, one sentence each.

failureMode.description: What the app should do when this stage fails to load.
